title: test: harden agent host unit tests against CI timing
body:
## Summary
- Allow 10 seconds for the disk-backed SQLite migration/provenance tests that exceeded Mocha's 2-second default on Linux in [build 476184, Run unit tests (node.js)](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/a6d41577-0fa3-498e-af22-257312ff0545/_build/results?buildId=476184&view=logs&j=193e9987-1fae-53fa-a82e-3ae14c27c30d&t=05f9e92d-6067-580b-3327-f249bac4f30e).
- Allow 10 seconds for the two Windows tests that start PowerShell, one of which timed out in [build 476235, Run unit tests (node.js)](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/a6d41577-0fa3-498e-af22-257312ff0545/_build/results?buildId=476235&view=logs&j=15ec5277-fdc6-550c-b203-acb65f44f31c&t=21220568-56a6-5295-046c-0daf7f78906b).
- Keep assertions and all other test timeouts unchanged. The Windows worker timeout later in build 476235 is a separate issue.

## Validation
- npm run compile-client (0 errors)
- npm run test-node -- --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/agentHostDatabase.test.ts --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/agentService.test.ts --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/shellInitScript.test.ts (605 passing, 20 pending)
- git diff --check

CI validation is still needed to confirm robustness under build-agent load.
